title: About this Wiki
text:
About us

    MKReyesH



Powered By

GitHub Pages: Hosting and deployment infrastructure.
Quarto: Markdown rendering, cross-referencing, and website generation.
Pandoc: Document format translation.
Bootstrap and Bootswatch: CSS support and user interface.
MathJax: Mathematical notation rendering.
Gemini: Help writing the Lua filters.



Contributing
If you would like to contribute to the core template, add new LaTeX translation rules, or fix a bug, do not hesitate to open a Pull Request at the GitHub Repository.
